prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after adoption (sign_in, reorder) was helpful (+7.0%), though a second test showed no clear effect.
Adding a new flow on home (home, new_flow) and quality guidance hints for adoption (adoption, hint) were helpful (+8.6% and +5.4%).
Streamlining path selection copy (choose_path, copy) hurt performance (-4.7%).
Grid selection layouts, background notifications, desktop tutorial screens, wait info/hints, copy updates, and interactive path story arcs showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, but a new home flow strongly outperformed its prediction (+8.6% measured vs +1.0% predicted).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +5.4% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, layout: +2.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -4.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, new_flow: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +3.7% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -0.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: +5.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, hint: +4.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +8.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.6% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 83.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Desktop Placement Verification Flow: Adds an automated screen check and workspace rendering test right after waiting to confirm the pet displays properly. (why: Three support emails reported pets not showing up on desktop or the app failing to open, and home waiting time has a high mean of 2336s.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Control Summary Screen: Adds a final setup screen detailing system tray shortcuts, hiding/showing pet toggles, and interaction commands. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after setup.)
2: [home, wait_info] Background Pet Preparation Progress: Enables progress bar and time estimate display on the waiting screen while background assets build. (why: The waiting step on home has a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off before reaching home.)
3: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Name Lock Incentive: Adds an official adoption badge and styled name input component to solidify pet adoption commitment. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 64.2% with a long mean duration of 1017s.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Tray Quick Launch Copy: Updates home introduction headline and body copy to directly explain where to locate the pet on the screen and system tray. (why: Multiple support emails noted post-onboarding confusion on finding and interacting with the pet on the desktop.)
5: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Delay To Final Setup Stage: Moves the sign-in screen to after the home waiting step, right before the final introduction. (why: Reordering sign-in later previously provided a +7.0% boost by allowing users to complete pet creation before account sign-in friction.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Switch Flexibility Hint: Adds a hint informing users that chosen companion paths can be changed or expanded anytime later in settings. (why: High mean time on choose_path (514s) indicates hesitation; explicit flexibility reduces decision friction.)

scores.note: Strong precedent for home new_flow (+8.6%) and strong evidence from wait time plus support emails, but requires new flow development.
High drop-off step and direct support emails, but adding new screens previously yielded negative lift (-0.4%).
Funnel shows long wait times, but wait info updates previously tested negative (-0.5%) with no support mail backing.
Targeting a high drop-off step (35.8% lost) with UI component updates, though lacking support email evidence.
Low cost copy update backed by support complaints and positive history for finish copy (+3.7%).
Reordering sign_in has proven positive results (+3.6% to +7.0% measured across past tests).
Low implementation cost, but path selection copy/hints have shown negative or negligible historical impact.
